subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'DEVOUR' is written as 'WGEQFT' and 'VARIED' is written as 'ECIKVF'. How will 'BLANKET' be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] Logic : Alternately opposite letter is written and (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series respectively. So, • 'DEVOUR' is written as 'WGEQFT'
tags: Coding and Decoding By Letter Shifting
